name: process
summary: Extract deterministic structured meeting notes from one transcript.
description: Reference app capability for meeting notes that genuinely reads the `transcript` input: scans it line by line (split on newlines/periods) for action-item keywords ("will", "todo", "action item"), decision keywords ("decided", "decision", "agreed"), and follow-up keywords ("follow up", "follow-up", "next step"), heuristically extracting an owner/made_by (the line's leading capitalized word) and a due date (the word following "by") where present. This replaces the 1.0.1 fixture, which always returned the same hardcoded fields regardless of input. Known limitation, disclosed rather than hidden: the owner/made_by heuristic can false-positive on any sentence-initial capitalized word, including pronouns (e.g. "We agreed..." yields made_by="We") -- acceptable for a reference-tier, no-model capability, not production-grade named-entity recognition. Built no_std on the shared agents/wasi-agent-runtime/ shim: verified to import only wasi_snapshot_preview1::{fd_read, fd_write, proc_exit}, so it is genuinely executable by Traverse's runtime, not just a generic wasmtime host. Source: agents/meeting-notes-process/ in this repo.

use_cases.scenario: A transcript with one action-item sentence and one decision sentence extracts both with owner/due and made_by.

input_example.transcript: Bob will send the report by Friday. Alice decided we should ship next week.

action_items.task: Bob will send the report by Friday

decisions.text: Alice decided we should ship next week

output_example.summary: 1 action item, 1 decision, and 0 follow-ups identified from 2 lines of transcript.

use_cases.scenario: A transcript with none of the three signal keywords yields empty arrays, not an error.

input_example.transcript: We had a nice chat about the weather today

output_example.summary: 0 action items, 0 decisions, and 0 follow-ups identified from 1 line of transcript.

use_cases.scenario: A 'follow up' phrase is captured as a follow-up, distinct from action items and decisions.

input_example.transcript: Follow up with legal about the contract terms.

follow_ups: Follow up with legal about the contract terms
output_example.summary: 0 action items, 0 decisions, and 1 follow-up identified from 1 line of transcript.

preconditions.description: The caller provides a transcript string. Empty transcripts are accepted and produce empty collections.

postconditions.description: The capability returns summary/action_items/decisions/follow_ups fields genuinely derived from the provided transcript -- distinct inputs produce distinct outputs, deterministically.

side_effects.description: Produces deterministic meeting-note metadata from the provided input.
